experiments.requires: step 5 code (search.robber_corr, search.kick, catanbot/robber_eval.py, catanbot/knightkick.py, decision_shadow.py --robber-gates) is in the working tree; a command row is not tunable-checked, so enable it by hand after --bump-code --areas robber (epoch B3)
experiments.notes: The knight_kick fallback rule (docs/PRIORITY_PLAN.md cross-area conflicts): PASS when R1a fails shadow gate G1 (inert) or G4 (too slow); never after a win-rate SHELVE, never stacked with R1a in one arm (the hub refuses kick with persistence on).

experiments.name: robber_gate_r1b
experiments.requires: step 5 code (search.robber_corr, search.kick, catanbot/robber_eval.py, catanbot/knightkick.py, decision_shadow.py --robber-gates) is in the working tree; a command row is not tunable-checked, so enable it by hand after --bump-code --areas robber (epoch B3)
experiments.notes: R1b knight insurance shadow gates: G1 >= 3% of knight holders' roll / main first actions change; G2 >= 60% of the holder decisions whose knight play flips follow exposure (kept with P_hit above its median, spent below it; the design's literal 'kept while exposed' share is reported as kept_exposed); G3 <= 1% of non-holders' change; G4 |mean C_ins| over insured leaves <= 0.05 points (centring); G5 ms ratio <= 1.3. PASS = INSURANCE_W goes to the SPSA robber group (a request to its owner); no standalone A/B.

experiments.name: robber_gate_r1c
experiments.requires: step 5 code (search.robber_corr, search.kick, catanbot/robber_eval.py, catanbot/knightkick.py, decision_shadow.py --robber-gates) is in the working tree; a command row is not tunable-checked, so enable it by hand after --bump-code --areas robber (epoch B3)
experiments.notes: R1c block duration shadow gate: >= 2% of robber / knight decisions change (readouts: P(needed card), leader hits, blocked pips, offensive knights). PASS = BLOCK_DUR_W goes to the SPSA robber group (a request to its owner); no standalone A/B.

experiments.name: robber_persistence
experiments.requires: step 5 (search.robber_corr, robber_eval: BLOCKED until --bump-code --areas robber) and its shadow gates G1-G4 (robber_gate_r1a)
experiments.notes: R1a: seqtest screen over 2,400 self-play games (paired VP difference co-primary in the design); self-play because R1a is nearly inert against Catanatron (about 2% of our robber moves hit a knight holder there). Power ~0.31 at +1.5 pp: screened once anyway (plan decision 1, screen_once). Mechanism readout (seat observer 'robber', catanbot/robber_metrics.py): rob_on_knight_holder at <= 50% of the default's rate; guards: army_end share down <= 3 pp, knights_played within 0.3 a game (needs ablate.py to pass observers: a request to its owner).
